C08-M05-L04-F1.title: The alert validation workflow
C08-M05-L04-F1.caption: Six steps that test an alert's claim against the evidence; a new entity found on the way becomes a new claim.
C08-M05-L04-F1.alt: Flow diagram, top to bottom: State the claim (R1: Word started PowerShell on WS-104); Reproduce the rule logic (re-run the query; check fields, thresholds, joins); Read the raw event (fields the normalised view dropped); Pivot across sources (same host, user or address within a time window); Seek refuting evidence (approved script, change ticket, owner); Conclude (confirmed, refuted or undetermined, with evidence). A side note beside Conclude reads: new entity found? it becomes a new claim: restart at step 1.

C08-M05-L04-F1.note: Every step can end the workflow early: a rule that matched the wrong event is a false positive before any pivot.
